description: This file declares the IpcClient class and related accessor class, which implement an IPC client interface for communication with a server, including methods for connection management, thread handling, and resource creation.

classes.name: IpcClientAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to an IIpcClient instance, implementing the IIpcClientAccessor interface.

classes.name: IpcClient
classes.description: Implements the IIpcClient interface, managing IPC communication, connection lifecycle, and resource creation for the client side of IPC.

methods.name: IpcClientAccessor::getIpcClient
methods.description: Returns a reference to the associated IIpcClient instance.

methods.name: IpcClient::IpcClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IPC client with factory dependencies.

methods.name: IpcClient::getChannel
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the IPC channel.

methods.name: IpcClient::createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates and returns a new blocking closure for IPC operations.

methods.name: IpcClient::createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RPC controller.

methods.name: IpcClient::processIpcThread
methods.description: Main loop for processing IPC communication in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: IpcClient::connect
methods.description: Establishes connection between the client and server.

methods.name: IpcClient::disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection between the client and server.
